lemmas.name: moveZeroes_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (arr : Array Int) (h : MoveZeroesToEnd_precond arr), MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond arr (Array.mk (arr.toList.filter (· ≠ 0) ++ arr.toList.filter (· = 0))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro arr h
  unfold MoveZeroesToEnd_postcond
  have hF : (0 : Int) ∉ arr.toList.filter (· ≠ 0) := by simp
  have hZ : (arr.toList.filter (· = 0)).idxOf 0 = 0 := by
    rcases hz : arr.toList.filter (· = 0) with _ | ⟨x, t⟩
    · rw [hz]; simp
    · have : x = 0 := by
        have : x ∈ arr.toList.filter (· = 0) := by rw [hz]; simp
        simpa using (List.mem_filter.mp this).2
      rw [hz, this]; simp
  have hi : (arr.toList.filter (· ≠ 0) ++ arr.toList.filter (· = 0)).idxOf 0 = (arr.toList.filter (· ≠ 0)).length := by
    rw [List.idxOf_append_of_notMem hF, hZ]; simp
  dsimp only
  rw [hi]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.isPerm_iff]
    have := List.filter_append_perm (fun x : Int => decide (x ≠ 0)) arr.toList
    simpa using this
  · exact List.take_left' rfl
  · exact List.drop_left' rfl
